#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""s01_custody.py -- TASK-20261002-3cd1f8 custody check (V1-1, TA-5).

Reads ONLY committed bytes via `git show <commit>:<path>`; writes copies to the
private scratch directory; hashes them against the snapshot receipt of
TASK-20261002-2a3049 and the ledger receipt of TASK-20261002-144a4f.
The prefix length is taken from the 144a4f receipt (hypothesis_v2_prefix_bytes),
never read back from the current file.  Own code; stdlib only (hashlib, json,
subprocess).
"""
import hashlib, json, subprocess, os, sys

REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
SNAP = "2f2c860710aef6e6c919ea60601f28bbfb7a5cf9"
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
OUT = os.path.join(SCR, "committed")

def show(commit, path):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{commit}:{path}"],
                          check=True, capture_output=True).stdout

def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

snap_receipt_path = ("coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-f435ab/"
                     "archives/TASK-20261002-2a3049/snapshot-receipt.json")
open_receipt_path = ("coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-f435ab/"
                     "archives/TASK-20261002-144a4f/ledger-receipt.json")
snap = json.loads(show(SNAP, snap_receipt_path))
opn = json.loads(show(SNAP, open_receipt_path))

FOUR = [
    "experiments/EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa/specification.yaml",
    "ledger/hypotheses/H-NISTBIN-dec5e1.yaml",
    "coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-f435ab/design/TASK-20261002-23efd5/proof-search-map-audit.yaml",
    "coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-f435ab/design/TASK-20261002-23efd5/revision-worksheet.yaml",
]
results = {"snapshot_commit": SNAP, "four_object_files": [], "frozen": {}, "prefix": {},
           "plan_and_card": [], "working_tree_equal_to_commit": {}}
ok_all = True
for p in FOUR:
    b = show(SNAP, p)
    exp = snap["path_sha256"][p]
    obs = sha(b)
    ok = (exp == obs)
    ok_all &= ok
    fn = os.path.join(OUT, os.path.basename(p))
    with open(fn, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b)
    results["four_object_files"].append({"path": p, "bytes": len(b), "expected": exp,
                                         "observed": obs, "match": ok})
    # working tree equality (informational only; review reads committed bytes)
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(REPO, p), "rb") as f:
            results["working_tree_equal_to_commit"][p] = (f.read() == b)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        results["working_tree_equal_to_commit"][p] = "absent"

# frozen copies, digests from TA-5 text of the plan (also in 144a4f receipt)
FROZEN = {
    "experiments/EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa/specification.v2-frozen-1ad01ce2.yaml":
        "1ad01ce2e913fc66c127688f6e718432fbb4de3a4b16174455ceec690ff5942d",
    "experiments/EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa/specification.v1-frozen-1088d03f.yaml":
        "1088d03f25e7cff8f581a0ed83c299301bba48013a4f26df560371b9e90b0d2d",
}
for p, exp in FROZEN.items():
    b = show(SNAP, p)
    obs = sha(b)
    ok = (exp == obs)
    ok_all &= ok
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, os.path.basename(p)), "wb") as f:
        f.write(b)
    results["frozen"][p] = {"bytes": len(b), "expected": exp, "observed": obs, "match": ok}

# hypothesis prefixes: byte length from the 144a4f receipt, never from the file
hyp = show(SNAP, "ledger/hypotheses/H-NISTBIN-dec5e1.yaml")
n_v2 = opn["hypothesis_v2_prefix_bytes"]
for label, n, exp in [("v2_prefix", n_v2, "28b713f12fb63b3eebd4a814093bf7311b244d78c0b69cfcd1060d02869db157"),
                      ("leading_28166", 28166, "b83b2a358bea10a29b6fca0fea4184e19ff9b257ade3a27ab5608ab33caa0b23")]:
    obs = sha(hyp[:n])
    ok = (obs == exp)
    ok_all &= ok
    results["prefix"][label] = {"bytes": n, "bytes_source": ("TASK-20261002-144a4f ledger-receipt.json "
                                "hypothesis_v2_prefix_bytes" if label == "v2_prefix" else "plan TA-5 literal"),
                                "expected": exp, "observed": obs, "match": ok}
results["prefix"]["hypothesis_total_bytes"] = len(hyp)
results["prefix"]["v2_prefix_ends_with_newline"] = hyp[n_v2 - 1:n_v2] == b"\n"
results["prefix"]["bytes_after_prefix_start"] = hyp[n_v2:n_v2 + 40].decode("utf-8", "replace")

# plan and this card vs 144a4f receipt
for p in ["coordination/review/nistbin-20261002-f435ab/review-plan.yaml",
          "ledger/handoffs/TASK-20261002-3cd1f8.yaml",
          "ledger/decisions/DEC-20261002-0983f2.yaml"]:
    b = show(SNAP, p)
    exp = opn["path_sha256"][p]
    obs = sha(b)
    results["plan_and_card"].append({"path": p, "expected_144a4f": exp, "observed_at_2f2c860710": obs,
                                     "match": exp == obs})
    with open(os.path.join(REPO, p), "rb") as f:
        results["working_tree_equal_to_commit"][p] = (f.read() == b)

# what did the snapshot commit change? (custody: producer's four R-FORM paths + gate + receipt)
names = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", "--name-status", "--format=", SNAP],
                       check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split("\n")
results["snapshot_commit_name_status"] = [x for x in names if x.strip()]
results["all_custody_checks_match"] = ok_all
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""s04_appendix_parser.py -- TASK-20261002-3cd1f8, joint J1 item (i).

OWN, INDEPENDENT parser of Appendix A ("Curve Details") of
inputs/CERTICOM-CHALLENGE-2009/challenge-2009_text.md, read from the committed
bytes at the snapshot commit (git show), never from a modified copy.

Design (deliberately NOT CB-1's method):
  * a curve label is recognised only inside an '=' banner: a line whose
    stripped text is ECC2-<d>, ECC2K-<d> or ECCp-<d> whose nearest preceding
    non-empty line is a run of '=' characters (page-number lines tolerated
    nowhere in that test); every label-shaped line anywhere in the document is
    also counted separately, to expose label mentions outside banners;
  * fields are read by a key/value state machine ("key =", "key:=", "key="),
    hex groups collected from the key line and its continuation lines;
    a continuation line holding a single token of at most two characters is
    treated as AMBIGUOUS (page number or displaced token) and reported, never
    silently absorbed;
  * r (printed as n) and h are validated by an exact-integer Hasse test
    (h r - 2^m - 1)^2 <= 4 * 2^m, by listing EVERY positive integer h that
    passes it, and by a primality test of r (sympy.isprime, BPSW).
Libraries: stdlib (re, json, subprocess, math), sympy (isprime), mpmath (log2).
No curve is instantiated; no point arithmetic; integers only.
"""
import json, math, re, subprocess, sys
import mpmath as mp
from sympy import isprime

mp.mp.dps = 50
REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
SNAP = "2f2c860710aef6e6c919ea60601f28bbfb7a5cf9"
PATH = "inputs/CERTICOM-CHALLENGE-2009/challenge-2009_text.md"

raw = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{SNAP}:{PATH}"], check=True,
                     capture_output=True).stdout
text = raw.decode("utf-8")
lines = text.split("\n")                      # index i  <->  line i+1

LABEL = re.compile(r"^(ECC2K|ECC2|ECCp)-(\d+)$")
BANNER = re.compile(r"^=+$")
KEYLINE = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z_]*)\s*:?=\s*(.*)$")
SEPARATOR = re.compile(r"^-{5,}")
HEX = re.compile(r"^[0-9A-Fa-f]+$")

# --- locate Appendix A independently: every heading occurrence, and the first banner-label
heading_idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.strip() == "A Curve Details"]
label_anywhere = [(i + 1, l.strip()) for i, l in enumerate(lines) if LABEL.match(l.strip())]

def prev_nonempty(i):
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and lines[j].strip() == "":
        j -= 1
    return j

banner_labels = []
for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    s = l.strip()
    mt = LABEL.match(s)
    if mt:
        j = prev_nonempty(i)
        if j >= 0 and BANNER.match(lines[j].strip()):
            banner_labels.append((i, mt.group(1), s, int(mt.group(2))))

first_banner_line = banner_labels[0][0] + 1 if banner_labels else None
appendix_heading_used = max(h for h in heading_idx if h < banner_labels[0][0]) + 1

# --- parse blocks
blocks = []
for b_i, (i, fam, label, suffix) in enumerate(banner_labels):
    end = banner_labels[b_i + 1][0] if b_i + 1 < len(banner_labels) else len(lines)
    # block extent: from the opening banner line to the last non-empty, non-separator,
    # non-banner line before the next block's opening banner
    open_banner = prev_nonempty(i) + 1
    nxt_open = (prev_nonempty(banner_labels[b_i + 1][0]) if b_i + 1 < len(banner_labels) else len(lines))
    fields = {}            # key -> list of (line_no, tokens)
    order = []
    ambiguous = []          # standalone short tokens: (line, token, current_key)
    cur = None
    last_content = i + 1
    for q in range(i + 1, end):
        s = lines[q].strip()
        if q >= nxt_open:
            break
        if s == "" or BANNER.match(s) or SEPARATOR.match(s):
            continue
        if s.startswith("Part ") or s.startswith("A Curve"):
            continue
        last_content = q + 1
        km = KEYLINE.match(lines[q])
        if km and not HEX.match(s.replace(" ", "")):
            cur = km.group(1)
            order.append((q + 1, cur))
            toks = km.group(2).split()
            fields.setdefault(cur, []).append((q + 1, toks))
            continue
        toks = s.split()
        if len(toks) == 1 and len(toks[0]) <= 2:
            ambiguous.append({"line": q + 1, "token": toks[0], "after_key": cur})
            continue
        if cur is not None:
            fields.setdefault(cur, []).append((q + 1, toks))
    blocks.append({"label": label, "family": fam, "suffix": suffix,
                   "label_line": i + 1, "open_banner_line": open_banner + 0,
                   "last_content_line": last_content, "fields": fields,
                   "key_order": order, "ambiguous": ambiguous})

def hexval(entries):
    toks = []
    for (_ln, ts) in entries:
        toks.extend(ts)
    s = "".join(toks)
    if s == "" or not HEX.match(s):
        return None, s
    return int(s, 16), s

def hasse_ok(h, r, m):
    d = h * r - (2 ** m + 1)
    return d * d <= 4 * (2 ** m)

def all_h(r, m):
    # every positive integer h with (h r - 2^m - 1)^2 <= 4 * 2^m
    q = (2 ** m + 1) // r
    return [h for h in range(max(1, q - 3), q + 4) if hasse_ok(h, r, m)]

out = {"input_path": PATH, "input_sha256_note": "bytes from git show at the snapshot commit",
       "heading_lines": [h + 1 for h in heading_idx],
       "appendix_heading_line_used": appendix_heading_used,
       "first_banner_label_line": first_banner_line,
       "label_shaped_lines_anywhere": label_anywhere,
       "banner_label_count": len(banner_labels),
       "curves": []}

for blk in blocks:
    f = blk["fields"]
    rec = {"curve": blk["label"], "family": blk["family"],
           "binary": blk["family"] in ("ECC2", "ECC2K"),
           "label_suffix": blk["suffix"], "label_line": blk["label_line"],
           "block_first_line": blk["open_banner_line"], "block_last_content_line": blk["last_content_line"],
           "ambiguous_standalone_tokens": blk["ambiguous"]}
    if rec["binary"]:
        m_entries = f.get("m", [])
        rec["m_lines"] = [ln for (ln, _t) in m_entries]
        rec["m"] = int(m_entries[0][1][0]) if len(m_entries) == 1 else None
        f_entries = f.get("f", [])
        fexp = None
        if f_entries:
            mm = re.match(r"x\^(\d+)", "".join(f_entries[0][1]))
            fexp = int(mm.group(1)) if mm else None
        rec["field_poly_leading_exponent"] = fexp
        a_entries = f.get("a", [])
        b_entries = f.get("b", [])
        rec["a_lines"] = [ln for (ln, _t) in a_entries]
        rec["b_lines"] = [ln for (ln, _t) in b_entries]
        rec["a_count"] = len([1 for (ln, t) in a_entries if t] ) + len([1 for (ln, t) in a_entries if not t])
        av, _ = hexval(a_entries)
        bv, _ = hexval(b_entries)
        # a printed twice (CR-2): hexval concatenates; report both raw
        rec["a_raw_tokens"] = [" ".join(t) for (_ln, t) in a_entries]
        rec["b_raw_tokens"] = [" ".join(t) for (_ln, t) in b_entries]
        rec["a_value_if_single"] = av if len(a_entries) == 1 else None
        rec["b_value"] = bv
        h_entries = f.get("h", [])
        n_entries = f.get("n", [])
        rec["h_lines"] = [ln for (ln, _t) in h_entries]
        rec["n_lines"] = [ln for (ln, _t) in n_entries]
        rv, rhex = hexval(n_entries)
        rec["r_hex"] = rhex
        rec["r_hex_digits"] = len(rhex)
        hv, hraw = hexval(h_entries)
        rec["h_printed_raw"] = hraw
        rec["h_printed_hex_value"] = hv
        m = rec["m"]
        if rv is not None and m is not None:
            rec["r_bit_length"] = rv.bit_length()
            rec["log2_r"] = float(mp.log(mp.mpf(rv), 2))
            rec["r_is_prime"] = bool(isprime(rv))
            rec["h_values_passing_hasse"] = all_h(rv, m)
            rec["printed_h_passes_hasse"] = (hasse_ok(hv, rv, m) if hv is not None else None)
            rec["suffix_equals_r_bit_length"] = (blk["suffix"] == rv.bit_length())
            rec["suffix_equals_hr_bit_length"] = (None if hv is None else blk["suffix"] == (hv * rv).bit_length())
            rec["n_lines_within_block_extent"] = all(blk["open_banner_line"] <= ln <= blk["last_content_line"] for ln in rec["n_lines"])
            # continuation lines of n (lines carrying hex groups after the n key line)
            rec["n_value_line_numbers"] = [ln for (ln, t) in n_entries if t]
    else:
        # prime-field block: p is the field prime; printed r is the seed-derived value, n the order
        pv, _ = hexval(f.get("p", []))
        nv, _ = hexval(f.get("n", []))
        hv, hraw = hexval(f.get("h", []))
        rec["p_bit_length"] = pv.bit_length() if pv else None
        rec["m"] = None
        rec["h_printed_raw"] = hraw
        rec["h_printed_hex_value"] = hv
        rec["order_n_bit_length"] = nv.bit_length() if nv else None
        rec["order_n_is_prime"] = bool(isprime(nv)) if nv else None
        if pv and nv and hv:
            d = hv * nv - (pv + 1)
            rec["hasse_prime_field"] = d * d <= 4 * pv
    out["curves"].append(rec)

bin_rows = [c for c in out["curves"] if c["binary"]]
out["summary"] = {
    "curves_total": len(out["curves"]),
    "binary_curves": len(bin_rows),
    "prime_field_curves": len(out["curves"]) - len(bin_rows),
    "binary_degrees": sorted(set(c["m"] for c in bin_rows)),
    "binary_degree_count": len(set(c["m"] for c in bin_rows)),
    "binary_pairs": [(c["curve"], c["m"]) for c in bin_rows],
    "every_binary_r_prime": all(c.get("r_is_prime") for c in bin_rows),
    "every_binary_unique_hasse_h": all(len(c.get("h_values_passing_hasse", [])) == 1 for c in bin_rows),
    "every_suffix_equals_r_bit_length": all(c.get("suffix_equals_r_bit_length") for c in bin_rows),
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=str))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""s05_rho.py -- TASK-20261002-3cd1f8: the Q1 rho column, recomputed from primary inputs.

FIPS 186-4 D.1.3 decimal base-point orders (inputs/FIPS186-4-BINARY-CURVES/fips186-4_text.md)
are parsed by this script and CROSS-CHECKED, as integers, against SEC 2 v2 hex orders
(inputs/SAFECURVES-20260825/specs/sec2-v2.txt), a second primary source with its own
transcription. Certicom r comes from s04's own Appendix-A parse. Bailey 2009's l for
ECC2K-130 is compared with Certicom's printed r. Every r is tested prime (sympy.isprime)
and h r is tested in the Hasse interval exactly.
rho(c) = 0.5 log2(pi r / (4 k)), k = m for a Koblitz curve over F_2 used over F_(2^m),
k = 1 otherwise (the contract's definitions.rho). mpmath, 50 digits.
"""
import json, os, re, subprocess
import mpmath as mp
from sympy import isprime
mp.mp.dps = 50
REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
SNAP = "2f2c860710aef6e6c919ea60601f28bbfb7a5cf9"
SCR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
def show(p):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{SNAP}:{p}"], check=True,
                          capture_output=True).stdout.decode("utf-8")
fips = show("inputs/FIPS186-4-BINARY-CURVES/fips186-4_text.md").split("\n")
sec2 = show("inputs/SAFECURVES-20260825/specs/sec2-v2.txt").split("\n")
bailey = show("inputs/BAILEY-2009-541-ECC2K130/paper_fulltext.md")

# ---- FIPS D.1.3: decimal n per curve section (from heading to 'Polynomial Basis')
fips_n = {}
for i, l in enumerate(fips):
    mt = re.match(r"^D\.1\.3\.\d+\.\d+\s+Curve\s+([KB]-\d+)", l.strip())
    if not mt or i < 6600:
        continue
    lab = mt.group(1)
    j = i + 1
    digits = []
    while j < len(fips) and "Polynomial Basis" not in fips[j]:
        s = fips[j].replace("\\", " ").replace("a =", " ").replace("n =", " ")
        for tok in re.findall(r"\d+", s):
            if len(tok) >= 3:   # v2 of this script: 10 dropped the 5-digit tails of K-571/B-571 (caught by the SEC 2 check)
                digits.append(tok)
        j += 1
    fips_n[lab] = int("".join(digits))

# ---- SEC 2 v2: hex n and h per sectXXX(k1|r1) recommended-parameters section
sec_n, sec_h = {}, {}
heads = [(i, re.match(r"^3\.\d+\.\d+RecommendedParameterssect(\d+)(k1|r1)$", l.strip()))
         for i, l in enumerate(sec2)]
heads = [(i, m) for (i, m) in heads if m and i > 3000]
for idx, (i, mt) in enumerate(heads):
    end = heads[idx + 1][0] if idx + 1 < len(heads) else len(sec2)
    lab = ("K-" if mt.group(2) == "k1" else "B-") + mt.group(1)

                                         and all(lo <= x <= hi for x in c["h_lines"])
                                         and all(lo <= x <= hi for x in c["n_value_line_numbers"]))
    out.append(rec)
summary = {"rows": len(out), "m_all_equal": all(x["m_equal"] for x in out), "h_all_equal": all(x["h_equal"] for x in out),
           "koblitz_rows": sum(1 for x in out if "koblitz_ab_equal" in x),

           "locators_not_covering_n": [x["curve"] for x in out if not x["locator_covers_label_m_h_n"]]}
